_comment: The lane builder's test corpus (docs/lanes-robustness.md). Two kinds of scene:
'authored' graphs were written by hand FOR the builder; 'planned' ones are the city planner's
(city_plan scene, assets/lanelab/planned/), the path a real city takes. The split is the point --
authored input is what the builder was written against, planned input is what it is handed, so a
gate that only ran the authored half would report a health the system does not have. (The planned
half was 'imported': recipes of the old metro grower through lanes_tool from-level, until the grower
retired, ADR-0267.) Add a scene here, not in the script.

The four scenes after ring_city were authored on 2026-09-20 for the gaps the first run exposed: no freeway-to-freeway crossing anywhere (ring_city carries a freeway over ARTERIALS, which is not the same test), no 2->1 ramp merge, and no sustained grade.

scenes.name: valley_viaduct
scenes.tests: a viaduct over a valley: piers, structure, clearance

scenes.name: ring_city
scenes.tests: ring road and arterials, the largest authored scene

scenes.name: freeway_cross
scenes.tests: two FREEWAYS crossing, one carried over the other on piers (flat ground, so the scene is about the crossing)

scenes.name: freeway_cross_relief
scenes.tests: the same crossing with relief under it: the carried road must climb to its hold and back inside its window

scenes.name: merge_taper
scenes.tests: on-ramps merging: one lane, then two dying into one over a short dovetail and a long one

scenes.name: steep_climb
scenes.tests: sustained 6% ground under a 4% road, a hill on top, a crossing on the slope and a ramp climbing off it

scenes.name: system_interchange
scenes.tests: a radial expressway under an elevated ring at ground level, their system interchange (two corner connectors, two loops), and the expressway's inner leg as a one-way boulevard pair meeting a boulevard at two Ts. Written by `lanes_tool interchange-demo`: regenerate it when the generator changes.

scenes.name: river_town
scenes.tests: a 1.6 km planned town on metro's world: a river through it, bridges, the ring at the city's edge

scenes.name: metro_v2_test
scenes.tests: a coast city: the ring opened into a C against the sea, its ends landing on streets (ADR-0266)

scenes.name: metro_planned
scenes.tests: the 3 km planned metro: the ring, two expressways, the outer loop and its towns

scenes.name: piedmont
scenes.tests: an 8 km world's city and the two towns at its expressways' ends
